title: Senior React Developer for SaaS Dashboard
description: We need an experienced React developer to build a complex analytics dashboard with real-time charts, advanced filtering, and a clean, modern UI. You'll work closely with our design team to implement pixel-perfect components and ensure smooth animations throughout.

title: Mobile App UI/UX Redesign
description: Redesign our existing iOS and Android travel app with a focus on improving conversion and bookings. Looking for a designer with strong portfolio in travel or e-commerce apps. Figma proficiency required.

title: Brand Identity for Coffee Roastery
description: Create a complete brand identity for our new specialty coffee roastery, including logo, color palette, typography system, and packaging design guidelines. We aim for a warm, artisanal feel.

title: Node.js Backend for E-commerce Platform
description: Build a scalable Node.js backend for our multi-vendor e-commerce platform. Includes payment integration, order management, vendor dashboards, and a robust REST API used by web and mobile clients.

title: Content Writer for Tech Blog
description: We're looking for a technical writer to produce 4 long-form articles per month on web development, AI, and developer tooling. Must have hands-on coding experience and ability to explain complex topics clearly.

title: AI Chatbot Integration Specialist
description: Integrate a HIPAA-compliant AI chatbot into our patient portal. Experience with OpenAI APIs, prompt engineering, and healthcare data privacy is essential.

title: Shopify Store Setup & Customization
description: Set up a Shopify store for our independent fashion brand with custom theme tweaks, product imports, and basic SEO configuration. Smaller agencies and freelancers welcome.

title: Video Editor for YouTube Channel
description: Edit weekly long-form travel and documentary videos (15-25 min). Must be skilled in pacing, color grading, and sound design. Provide samples of similar work in your application.

title: Data Engineer — ETL Pipelines
description: Design and implement robust ETL pipelines pulling from 12+ data sources into our warehouse. Strong experience with Airflow, dbt, and Snowflake required.

title: WordPress Plugin Developer
description: Build a custom WordPress plugin that integrates our hosting management API with the WP admin dashboard. Clean code, security, and updateability are top priorities.

title: Social Media Manager — B2B SaaS
description: Manage our LinkedIn and X presence: content calendar, post drafting, community engagement, and performance reporting. B2B SaaS experience strongly preferred.

title: iOS Developer — Fitness App MVP
description: Build the first version of our iOS fitness app: workout tracking, HealthKit integration, social leaderboards, and push notifications. Swift + SwiftUI preferred.

title: Translator — English to Japanese
description: Translate ~25,000 words of marketing and product documentation from English to Japanese. Native-level Japanese and tech industry familiarity required.
